SKUItemQuantity
".format(HOSTNAME, rows) self.send_body(200, body, "text/html; charset=utf-8") else: self.send_body(404, json.dumps({"error": "not found"}), "application/json") def log_message(self, fmt, *args): print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args)) HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), InventoryHandler).serve_forever() PYEOF sudo chmod 0755 /opt/inventory/app.py sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory.service >/dev/null <<'SVCEOF' [Unit] Description=Inventory web application After=network-online.target Wants=network-online.target [Service] Type=simple User=nobody Group=nogroup WorkingDirectory=/opt/inventory ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory/app.py Restart=always RestartSec=2 [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target SVCEOF sudo systemctl daemon-reload sudo systemctl enable inventory.service sudo systemctl restart inventory.service systemctl is-active inventory.service systemctl is-enabled inventory.service ss -tlnp | grep ':8080 ' curl -fsS "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"

	log /dev/log	local1 notice
	chroot /var/lib/haproxy
	stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin
	stats timeout 30s
	user haproxy
	group haproxy
	daemon

	# Default SSL material locations
	ca-base /etc/ssl/certs
	crt-base /etc/ssl/private

	# Default ciphers to use on SSL-enabled listening sockets.
	# For more information, see ciphers(1SSL). This list is from:
	#  https://hynek.me/articles/hardening-your-web-servers-ssl-ciphers/
	ssl-default-bind-ciphers ECDH+AESGCM:DH+AESGCM:ECDH+AES256:DH+AES256:ECDH+AES128:DH+AES:ECDH+3DES:DH+3DES:RSA+AESGCM:RSA+AES:RSA+3DES:!aNULL:!MD5:!DSS
	ssl-default-bind-options no-sslv3

defaults
	log	global
	mode	http
	option	httplog
	option	dontlognull
        timeout connect 5000
        timeout client  50000
        timeout server  50000
	errorfile 400 /etc/haproxy/errors/400.http
	errorfile 403 /etc/haproxy/errors/403.http
	errorfile 408 /etc/haproxy/errors/408.http
	errorfile 500 /etc/haproxy/errors/500.http
	errorfile 502 /etc/haproxy/errors/502.http
	errorfile 503 /etc/haproxy/errors/503.http
	errorfile 504 /etc/haproxy/errors/504.http

commands.command:
sudo tee /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg >/dev/null <<'HAPEOF'
global
    log /dev/log local0
    log /dev/log local1 notice
    chroot /var/lib/haproxy
    stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin
    stats timeout 30s
    user haproxy
    group haproxy
    daemon

defaults
    log global
    mode http
    option httplog
    option dontlognull
    timeout connect 5s
    timeout client 50s
    timeout server 50s

frontend inventory_frontend
    bind *:80
    default_backend inventory_backends

backend inventory_backends
    balance roundrobin
    option httpchk GET /health
    server node2 10.100.30.11:8080 check inter 2s fall 2 rise 2
    server node3 10.100.30.12:8080 check inter 2s fall 2 rise 2
HAPEOF
sudo haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
sudo systemctl enable haproxy.service
sudo systemctl restart haproxy.service
sleep 3
systemctl is-active haproxy.service
systemctl is-enabled haproxy.service
ss -tlnp | grep ':80 '
printf 'BACKEND_DIRECT\n'
curl -fsS http://10.100.30.11:8080/health
printf '\n'
curl -fsS http://10.100.30.12:8080/health
printf '\nBALANCED_REQUESTS\n'
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 6 ]; do curl -fsS "http://$NODE_IP/health"; printf '\n'; i=$((i+1)); done
